 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 OUT at hprca.hp.gov.in: Download Hall Ticket PDF Direct Link Active
 By Manish Kumar Last Updated: Nov 17, 2026, 12:07 IST HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 has been released by the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA) for the posts of Patwari against Post Code 25027. The Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari posts will be conducted from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. Candidates can download their hall ticket through the official website. Check all details here. 
 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 OUT at hprca.hp.gov.in: Download Hall Ticket PDF Direct Link Active 
 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 Out : The Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA), Hamirpur has released the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 on its official website. Candidates appearing in the Patwari written exam can download their hall ticket after using their login credentials to the link at -hprca.hp.gov.in. The Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari against Post Code 25027 is scheduled to be held from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. All those candidates who applied successfully for Patwari posts can download their hall ticket after using their login credentials at the official website of HPRCA-hprca.hp.gov.in.
 If you are facing any difficulties in downloading the admit card, you may contact the helpdesk through phone no: +919986638751 from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on all working days except Sunday and Gazetted holidays or raise a query from helpdesk tab which can be accessed after applicant login. 
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 Download Link 
 Candidates appearing in the Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari posts can download their hall ticket through the link at the official website-hprca.hp.gov.in. You can download the hall ticket directly thorugh the link given below- 
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 Download Link  
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 Overview
 It is expected that the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 has been released on the official website. It is crucial to download the admit card as soon as it is released to avoid last-minute issues. Candidates must enter their registration number and date of birth in the login portal to download the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026. It is essential to print a clear copy of the admit card and bring it to the exam venue.
 Organization Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA)

 How to Download HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates will have to enter their registration number and date of birth in the login portal to download the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026. It is essential to print a clear copy of the admit card and bring it to the exam venue. You can follow the steps given below to download your admit card-
 Visit the official website of HPRCA at https://hprca.hp.gov.in/.
 Open the Admit Card section on the homepage.
 Find the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 download link.
 Click on the relevant admit card link.
 Enter the required login details, as requested on the portal.
 Submit the details to access your admit card.
 Download the admit card and take a printout for future reference.
 What Is The Exam Pattern For HPRCA Patwari 2026? 
 The Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari against Post Code 25027  will be conducted from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. The exam pattern for the HP Patwari post is as follows: 
 The mode of the examination will be a Computer-Based Test (CBT). 
 The exam will consist of 120 questions. 
 Each question will carry 1 mark. 
 The duration of the exam is 90 minutes. 
 What To Do If Unable to login To Download The Hall Ticket? 
 If you are unable to download the HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 due to issue in login, then you are advised to try to log in after deleting cookies/old history. If you still face the same issue, then first contact the Helpdesk number and if required, then contact HPRCA via email/call. You are advised to follow the guidelines displayed on the official website. 
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card Download 2026: Documents Required to the Exam Venue For Verification
 Candidates appearing in the written exam for Patwari posts will have to carry the required documents at the exam venue for the verification purposes. Remember that the documents must be presented by the candidates at the exam venue as it ie essential condition for their entry in the exam venue. Below are list of documents as mentioned by the concerned authority HPRCA-
 Admit card,
 2 passport size photographs
 At least two original and valid photo identification card (i.e. not photocopied or scanned or expired) such as Voter Card, Aadhaar Card, printout of eAadhaar (verified), Driving License, PAN card, E-PAN Card Print out (verified), Passport.
